song.title: For God so loved
song.lyrics:
[V1] For God so loved, he gave his son for us, what a thought, what a gift! God loved us before we knew him, before we loved him, God loved us.
[C1] I have nothing to give to you, but the life you gave to me. My life and my love I give to you, for you gave your life first for me.
[V2] For Christ so loved, he gave his life for us, what a thought, what a gift! Christ loved us, before we knew him, before we loved him, Christ loved us.
[V3] Lord oh Lord, because you love me, how can I keep my love from you? You loved me before I knew you, before I loved you, Lord, you loved me.
song.author: Joel Soward
